description: List transactions. By default returns the last 30 days; pass start_date/end_date for an arbitrary period (e.g. Jan 1–31). Sync must be done first.

account.description: Filter by account name or UUID

category.description: Filter by category name or UUID

days.description: Number of days to look back from today (default 30). Ignored if start_date or end_date is provided.

end_date.description: End of date range (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. If omitted while start_date is set, defaults to today.

limit.description: Max number of transactions to return (default 50)

start_date.description: Start of date range (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. If omitted while end_date is set, defaults to unbounded.

name: list_transactions
